lcc_original: 永恆主上帝爲亞當【4】和他的妻子作了皮褂子給他們穿。
notes: LCC 皮褂子 merges UNV's 皮子 (WH05785, עוֹר skin/leather) and 衣服 (WH03801, כָּתְנוֹת tunics) into one compound word; both SNs attached to 皮褂子.
Footnote marker 【4】 preserved in-place after 亞當 as in the original LCC text.
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (WH03068); LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 (WH0430) — standard LCC substitutions.
作了: aspectual particle 了 carries no SN; verbal root 作 takes WH06213+WTH8799.
